items.name: q
items.desc: Advanced query — operators, quotes, negation (see Query syntax).

items.name: search
items.desc: Simple global substring match over sender, body, deviceId, messageId.

items.name: has
items.desc: Body contains pattern: otp, link, digits, email, amount.

items.name: match
items.desc: How free-text terms in q combine. Default all.

items.name: date
items.desc: Whole day (YYYY-MM-DD) in the given tz.

items.name: preset
items.desc: last1h, last24h, last7d, last30d, today, yesterday, thisMonth.

items.name: tz
items.desc: Client UTC offset in minutes (Bangladesh = 360). Affects day boundaries and group=day.

items.name: page / limit
items.desc: Offset pagination. limit max 500 (5000 for exports). Max offset 100,000.

items.name: cursor
items.desc: Keyset pagination — pass pagination.nextCursor. Fast at any depth; needs sortBy=receivedAt.

items.name: fields
items.desc: Projection. _id and receivedAt are always included.

items.name: highlight
items.desc: Adds a highlight snippet with **matched** text to each result.

items.name: total
items.desc: total=false skips the count query (faster on huge sets).

items.name: group
items.desc: Aggregate instead of list: sender, deviceId, type, simSlot, day, hour, month.

operators.desc: Contains otp / link / digits / email / amount
Exclude: works on words, phrases and any operator (-from:ads, -has:link, -type:outgoing)
Free words are ANDed across sender+body (use match=any for OR)

endpoints.title: Search & list messages
endpoints.desc: The main endpoint. Combine any filters below. Results are always scoped to the API key’s account.
endpoints.curl:
curl -G "https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'q=from:bkash has:otp -promo' \
  -d preset=last7d -d tz=360 -d highlight=true -d limit=20

endpoints.title: Count
endpoints.desc: Same filters, returns only the number of matches.

endpoints.title: Statistics / group-by
endpoints.desc: Aggregate matches by sender, deviceId, type, simSlot, day, hour or month.

endpoints.title: Export
endpoints.desc: Download matches as CSV or NDJSON (up to 5000 rows per request; use cursor to continue). Cells starting with = + - @ are escaped.
endpoints.curl: curl -G "https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -d format=csv -d limit=5000 -d from=2026-11-01 -o sms.csv

endpoints.title: Search / count / delete with a JSON body
endpoints.desc: Use when filters are too long for a URL. Body: { action: "search" | "count" | "delete", filters?: {…} }. Filters may also sit at the top level. Arrays are accepted for list fields.

endpoints.title: Bulk delete
endpoints.desc: Delete everything matching the filters (query string and/or JSON body). Safety rails: (1) needs a filter, ids, or confirmAll:true; (2) dryRun:true previews without deleting; (3) more than 1000 matches returns 409 until you resend with confirmCount equal to the match count. Also accepts ids (Mongo _ids) and messageIds, up to 1000 each.
endpoints.curl:
# preview first
curl -X DELETE "https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q":"from:promo before:2026-10-01","dryRun":true}'

# then really delete
curl -X DELETE "https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"q":"from:promo before:2026-10-01"}'

# by ids
curl -X DELETE "https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/messages" -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ids":["6740aa…","6740bb…"]}'

endpoints.title: Get one message
endpoints.desc: :id is a Mongo _id or a messageId (add ?deviceId= to disambiguate messageIds).

endpoints.title: Device sync (used by the Android app)
endpoints.desc: No API key — the User ID identifies the account and the deviceId must be on the allowed list (403 otherwise). Duplicates are ignored.
